Being attacked or evading enemy attacks temporarily increases your Basic/skill Atk. This skill's duration is renewed if you are attacked or evade an enemy attack again for its duration.
You are immune to blindness. You have a chance to evade any damage from behind.
Strikes the ground with your sword, sending a shock wave and creating a wave cage that attacks enemies.
Slashes upward at an enemy in front, and then casts a Wave Wheel, knocking enemies backward with multi-hit damage.
Requires Willingness buff status to cast. This skill casts a rupturing wave and pulls surrounding enemies towards you.

Releases your wave eye of mind and creates a temporary dark area where you become stronger and enemies become weaker. Enemies' Attack Speed will decrease in your zone.
Increases your Evasion rate. Wave Manifestation Mark status is permanent.
Creating a flaming zone in front that causes a massive explosion.
Shoots big ice pillars of along the ground.
Wave knocks enemies backward.
Inflicts enemies with shock when you deal any damage to them. Shock: stackable status that increases received damage.
Summons a lightning cloud and inflicts Light damage on enemies.
Summons a lightning cloud and inflicts Light damage on enemies.
Strikes the ground with your sword, sending a shock wave and creating a wave cage that attacks enemies and explodes when time expired.
Shoots small ice pillars of along the ground.

Releases your power of waves around you which pulls enemies away from you.
Periodically generates Wave Manifestations. Increases Casting Speed when cast.
Shoots a big spirit sword.
